correctness.rationale: Every dimension<=2 poset has a two-order realizer and is encoded by a permutation; height<=2 exactly means no increasing subsequence of length three (123 avoidance). Catalan insertion of successive maxima is exhaustive and reversible. The frozen verifier produces common-palette directed predecessor/successor 1-WL fingerprints after n rounds, groups all 123-avoiders, and compares every same-fingerprint representative via exact colour-restricted bijection backtracking preserving the full directed strict-order matrix. Isomorphic objects necessarily have identical fingerprints, and successful backtracking makes all objects within each signature group isomorphic. Independently rebuilt the generator, common-palette iterations and exact backtracking for every n=1..10: Catalan counts culminated in 16,796 n=10 representations, 4,502 groups, with type counts (1,2,4,9,21,55,151,447,1389,4502). This exhausts the finite theorem, not larger sizes or a least collision.
residual_risks: Finite computer-assisted exhaustive proof relies on faithful permutation generator, matrix encoding and complete backtracking; source and independent reconstruction agree.
The theorem proves no sharp first-failure size beyond 10.
